QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_67

question.text: An AIF charges 1.5% management fee on GNAV of INR 120 crore. GST at 18%. TOTAL cost to the fund (incl GST):

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook applies management fees on GNAV for Category III AIFs and adds GST at 18% on the management-fee amount. Mgmt fee = 1.5% x 120 = 1.80 crore; GST = 1.80 x 0.18 = 0.324 crore; Total = 1.80 + 0.324 = INR 2.124 crore. The Trap: Option A ignores GST. Option B applies the percentage incorrectly. Option C double-counts. Note: The all-in fee, inclusive of GST, is the cost actually borne by the fund.
